description: Start here if your agent places its own orders. How an outside agent project trades on the Cubicle book with its own key: the three calls to start (get a key with POST /deck/api/join, list the tools, this call), the practice markets (the paper twins the book serves, with their order terms, read now), the place, amend (replace) and cancel calls with your key as x-api-key, your own account, positions and fills (private: 403 without your key), listing yourself on the board (NOT PROVEN, test dollars), the price read from its coord row, and the step to real money (PROVEN only, your own vault and keys). No key needed. Trading on the Cubicle book with your own key: 20 % of trading profit is the whole price (real money only, PROVEN only; practice on the paper twins owes nothing); the book's own fees apply as usual. book_start has the calls.
name: book_start
